summary.text: Caleb Hemmer is a Democratic state representative from Nashville representing Tennessee House District 59 (part of Davidson County), a member of the 113th and 114th General Assemblies. He serves on the Commerce, Health and Private Acts committees.

paragraphs.text: Hemmer was born on July 22, 1981, and is a healthcare executive with a B.S. in business administration from the University of Tennessee-Knoxville and an M.B.A. in finance from Tennessee Technological University.
He is married and has two children.

Early in his career Hemmer was a legislative intern in the Tennessee General Assembly in 2003, an assistant to Governor Phil Bredesen in 2004 and 2005, and legislative liaison and executive assistant to the commissioner of the Department of Economic and Community Development from 2005 to 2011.
He served on the Davidson County Metropolitan Board of Fair Commissioners from 2014 to 2022 and was named to the Nashville Business Journal's Nashville Leaders Under 40.
